description_en: Queries the status of the Data Lake Analytics (DLA) service for a backup schedule
description_zh: 该接口用于查看备份计划的数据查询服务（DLA）
name: DescribeDLAService

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup schedule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to obtain the ID of the backup schedule
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.name: client_token

AutoAdd.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the feature of automatically adding incremental data to a data lake. If this feature is enabled, DBS adds the backup sets that are newly generated to the data lake that is created for the backup schedule. Valid values:

true: enables the feature.

false: disables the feature
AutoAdd.description_zh:
是否开启增量数据自动入湖，开启后，系统会自动将新产生的备份集添加入湖，取值：
true：开启
false：不开启

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

HaveJobFailed.description_en:
Indicates whether a failed DLA task exists in the return result. Valid values:

true: A failed DLA task exists.

false: No failed DLA task exists
HaveJobFailed.description_zh:
返回结果中是否存在失败的DLA任务，取值：
true：存在
false：不存在

State.description_en:
The status of the DLA service for the backup schedule. Valid values:

Running: DLA is running.

Closing: DLA is being disabled.

Closed: DLA is disabled
State.description_zh:
备份计划的DLA服务状态， 取值：
Running：运行中
Closing：关闭中
Closed：已关闭

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
